comment: Canonical upstream-TCL-suite adoption ledger. mode: native (harness spawns peadb-server), external (--host/--port, limited coverage), excluded (out of scope, reason required). last_counts/skipfile_lines are the ratchet baselines maintained by scripts/ci/check_suite_ratchet.py --update; regressions require a compat/delta.md change. The headline parity number is sum(ok)/sum(ok+err+skipfile_lines) over non-excluded suites (scripts/redis/parse_tcl_results.py).

unit/cluster.exclusion_reason: Full Redis Cluster is out of scope (single node + replication); see compat/delta.md item 6.

unit/moduleapi.exclusion_reason: Module certification out of scope; see compat/delta.md item 4.

unit/oom-score-adj.exclusion_reason: Linux-specific oom-score-adj not implemented; revisit with the ops/config sweep.

unit/tls.exclusion_reason: TLS not implemented (deferred XL track); see compat/delta.md item 7.
